objectivesText: Find Bishop DeLavey in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: The Missing Diplomat
objectivesText: Defeat Private Hendel in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: The Missing Diplomat
objectivesText: Defeat Dashel Stonefist in Stormwind.

quests.name: Bingles' Missing Supplies
objectivesText: Find and return Bingles' supplies:
Bingles' Wrench, Bingles' Screwdriver, Bingles' Hammer, and Bingles' Blastencapper.

quests.name: Find Bingles
objectivesText: Find Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Underground Assault
objectivesText: Retrieve the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from the Deadmines and return it to Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.

quests.name: Speak with Shoni
objectivesText: Speak with Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.

quests.name: Save Techbot's Brain!
objectivesText: Bring Techbot's Memory Core to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

quests.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
objectivesText: Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

quests.name: Essential Artificials
objectivesText: Bring 12 Essential Artificials to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.

quests.name: Gnogaine
objectivesText: Use the Empty Leaden Collection Phial on Irradiated Invaders or Irradiated Pillagers to collect radioactive fallout. Once it is full, take it back to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.

quests.name: The Day After
objectivesText: Speak with Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.

quests.name: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators
objectivesText: Bring twenty-four Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Grand Betrayal
objectivesText: Venture to Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque when the task is complete.

quests.name: Data Rescue
objectivesText: Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
objectivesText: Travel to Gnomeregan and bring back High Potency Radioactive Fallout. Be warned, the fallout is unstable and will collapse rather quickly.
Ozzie will also require your Heavy Leaden Collection Phial when the task is complete.

quests.name: Dragonkin Menace
objectivesText: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.
You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

quests.name: Marshal Windsor
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor.
You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

quests.name: Abandoned Hope
objectivesText: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

quests.name: A Crumpled Up Note
objectivesText: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

quests.name: A Shred of Hope
objectivesText: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information.
Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

quests.name: Jail Break!
objectivesText: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

quests.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
objectivesText: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

quests.name: The Great Masquerade
objectivesText: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

quests.name: The Dragon's Eye
objectivesText: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

quests.name: Drakefire Amulet
objectivesText: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

quests.name: Secure the Mountain
objectivesText: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.

quests.name: Secure the Mountain
objectivesText: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.

quests.name: Secure the Mountain
objectivesText: Deliver Mountaineer Gretchen's Report back to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
